title: Missing machine-readable dateModified and datePublished metadata on policy and documentation content
evidence: Pages such as https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/manifesto/ and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ provide foundational organizational principles and policies but lack dateModified/datePublished metadata or Article/WebPage schema, making it difficult for AI engines to machine-verify document currency.

suggested_action.summary: Add datePublished and dateModified metadata to policy and about documents.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Include schema.org 'dateModified' in JSON-LD or standard <meta property="article:modified_time"> on all durable documentation and manifesto pages.
